text.en: Dog owners consistently commend Ella for her gentle, patient approach with nervous, energetic, or rescue dogs. Reviewers appreciate that she takes time to build trust and provides a quiet one-to-one setting where sensitive pets feel comfortable and safe throughout their visit.

Clients describe Ella as welcoming, dedicated, and very easy to communicate with regarding individual coat requirements. Many reviewers praise her patience and practical suggestions for routine grooming maintenance, noting that she genuinely cares about each dog brought into her salon.

Owners report that dogs leave looking immaculate, with well-shaped coats, clean finishes, and carefully trimmed nails. Multiple clients note that both puppies and active working breeds look fresh and tidy, frequently booking repeat appointments weeks in advance.

q.en: Does the salon offer one-to-one appointments without other dogs?

a.en: Yes, clients note that Ella provides quiet one-to-one grooming sessions without other dogs present, which suits nervous or reactive pets.

q.en: Can energetic or large dog breeds be groomed here?

a.en: Reviewers mention successful grooming appointments for energetic spaniels, labradors, and large breeds.

q.en: How are the grooming prices rated by clients?

a.en: Pet parents highlight that the grooming service is very competitively and fairly priced for the high level of individual care provided.

q.en: Is One Ell of a Groom suitable for puppy first cuts?

a.en: Yes, owners praise Ella for introducing young puppies and terriers to grooming with gentle encouragement and patience.
